indicator.label: Tracking is on. Your location is recorded about every {minutes} minutes while this app is open. Open my day.
indicator.problem: Tracking is on, but your location is unavailable. Open my day.
indicator.pending: Tracking is on; your day start is waiting to sync. Open my day.

notice.title: Location tracking during working hours
notice.intro: Please read this before your first working day. You only need to acknowledge it once per version.
notice.legalPending: Draft text, pending the company's legal review.
notice.accept: I have read and understood this notice
notice.offline: Connect to the internet to acknowledge the notice.
notice.missing: Work-hours tracking is not set up yet. Ask your manager.

shift.title: My working day
shift.confirmEnd: End your working day now? Tracking stops.
shift.waiting: {count, plural, =0 {All points sent} one {One point waiting to send} other {# points waiting to send}}
shift.browserLimit: Points are only collected while this app is open with the screen on. Keep it open during your working day. A company app that also works in the background will follow.
shift.offHours: Your location is not collected now. It is collected only between Start my day and End my day.
shift.overdue: Your day passed the {hours}-hour maximum. It will be closed automatically and tracking has stopped.
shift.queuedStart: No connection: your day start is saved on this device and will be sent when you are back online.
shift.queuedEnd: No connection: your day end is saved on this device and will be sent when you are back online.
shift.startFailed: Your saved day start could not be applied. Start your day again.

geo.denied: Location access is blocked. Allow location for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
geo.unsupported: This browser cannot share its location. Use the company phone's browser.
geo.timeout: Your location could not be found in time. Your day starts without it.
geo.unavailable: Your location is unavailable right now. Your day starts without it.

errors.NOTICE_REQUIRED: Please acknowledge the tracking notice before you start your day.
errors.NOTICE_OUTDATED: The tracking notice was updated. Reload the page and read the new version.
errors.SHIFT_OPEN: Your working day is already started.
errors.NO_OPEN_SHIFT: Your working day was already closed.
errors.NO_EMPLOYEE_PROFILE: Your account is not linked to an employee record. Ask an administrator.

team.title: Field tracking
team.subtitle: Working-hours location, visits and stops of your team. These are signals to review with the rep, never automatic penalties.
team.empty: Nobody to show for this day.
team.count: {count, plural, =0 {No reps} one {One rep} other {# reps}}
team.flaggedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing flagged} one {One rep to review} other {# reps to review}}

day.title: {name}
day.pointsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No points} one {One point} other {# points}}
day.empty: No shift, visit or point on this day.
day.purged: The detailed points of this day were deleted after the retention period. Only the daily summary is kept.
day.explain: Stops are 30 minutes or more within 150 m. A stop is flagged when it is away from every visit and every customer location. Gaps are 20 minutes or more without a point during the shift.

timeline.stopFlagged: Stop away from customers and visits

routeError.title: This page could not be loaded
routeError.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, tell your administrator.
